info.description: Anvil is a terminal-based AI coding assistant. This API is served over a Unix socket (or Windows named pipe) and provides programmatic access to workspaces, sessions, agents, LSP, MCP, and more.
info.title: Anvil API

get.summary: Get last read time for file
Get all user messages for workspace

append_prompt.description:
AppendPrompt is injected verbatim at the end of the agent's system
prompt.

model.description:
Model is the full provider/model string (e.g. "anthropic/claude-opus-4-6").
An empty string falls back to the global large model.

skills.description:
AllowedSkills is the list of skill names available to the agent.
nil means all skills are available; [] means no skills.

tools.description:
AllowedTools is the list of tools available to the agent.
nil means all tools are available; [] means no tools.

variant.description: Variant is the model variant (e.g. thinking budget passthrough).

matcher.description: Regex pattern tested against the tool name. Empty means match all.

name.description: Friendly display name shown in the TUI. Falls back to Command when empty.

auth.description:
Auth selects the authentication method. Only "oauth" is
supported and only for HTTP/SSE servers.

headers.description:
Headers are HTTP headers for HTTP/SSE MCP servers. Values run
through shell expansion at MCP startup, so $VAR and $(cmd)
work. A header whose value resolves to the empty string (unset
bare $VAR under lenient nounset, $(echo), or literal "") is
omitted from the outgoing request rather than sent as
"Header:". See PLAN.md Phase 2 design decision #18.

lazy_description.description:
LazyDescription makes this MCP server's tools lazy-loaded. The
server still connects eagerly at startup, but its tools and
instructions are excluded from the LLM context until explicitly
enabled by the agent or human. The value is surfaced to the LLM
so it can decide when to enable the server.

allowed_tools.description:
AllowedTools is the deprecated flat list of tool names.
Kept for backward-compatible JSON parsing; migrated at load time.

path.description:
Path is the filesystem path to the plugin directory. Supports ~ and
environment variable expansion.

model.description:
The model id as used by the provider API.
Required.

provider.description:
The model provider, same as the key/id used in the providers config.
Required.

reasoning_effort.description: Only used by models that use the openai provider and need this set.

think.description: Used by anthropic models that can reason to indicate if the model should think.

variant.description: Variant is an optional model variant passthrough (e.g. thinking budget).

agents.description:
Agents is the map of named agent configurations. After SetupAgents,
only the orchestrator is present. The full roster is populated by
SetupAgentsWithDefaults when the coordinator loads .md files.

disabled_agents.description:
DisabledAgents lists agent names to remove from the routing table and
orchestrator prompt at startup.

env.description: Env is a map of environment variables set on startup.

models.description: We currently only support large/small as values here.

plugins.description:
Plugins is a list of external plugin directories to load skills,
commands, and agents from.

recent_models.description: Recently used models stored in the data directory config.

project_directory.description:
ProjectDirectory is where Anvil keeps per-project state such as
logs, workspace config, and .gitignore. Relative paths are
resolved against the working directory; absolute paths are used
verbatim. After defaulting the stored value is always absolute.

yolo.description:
YOLO is the legacy boolean field for backward compatibility with
older servers/clients. Prefer YoloLevel for granular control.
